subject.title: fix(memory): hide QMD transport metadata from recalled content

question: Should this PR include a provenance-safe repair for existing QMD recall rows, or be narrowed to future QMD results while legacy cleanup remains separately tracked?
rationale: The generic recall store does not record QMD transport provenance, and the new test proves that identical diff-hunk syntax can be legitimate content, so automatically choosing a migration policy could alter persisted memory state.

options.title: Narrow and separate legacy repair
options.body: Keep the adapter fix, remove the persisted-cleanup and full-closing claims, and track an owner-approved previewable QMD repair separately.

options.title: Add safe repair before merge
options.body: Delay merge until the branch can identify QMD-contaminated rows without rewriting legitimate generic diff content and can regenerate their concept tags with upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Narrow and separate legacy repair
recommendation.body: Keep the adapter fix, remove the persisted-cleanup and full-closing claims, and track an owner-approved previewable QMD repair separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the QMD adapter boundary and persistent memory repair policy, and steipete has the strongest recent history in the QMD manager path.
